title: JSON Pointer lab
description: Write RFC 6901 JSON Pointers into a JSON document, see what each one reaches or why it reaches nothing, and pick nodes from the document to get their pointers.
needs: an object with pointers ([{ id, pointer }], at least one) and a document (any JSON)

tools.name: addPointer
tools.description: Add a pointer; it gets the next free id (q1, q2, …).

tools.name: reorderPointers
tools.description: Move a pointer to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: setDocument
tools.description: Replace the JSON document the pointers resolve in.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Where any pointer leads in the document: its unescaped tokens, and the value it reaches, or the segment where it fails and why.

tools.name: find
tools.description: The pointers of nodes whose key or (scalar) value contains a text, ignoring case (at most 50).
